items.title: Parabilis eyes $475m IPO to push lead asset into Phase III
items.summary: Regeneron-backed Parabilis will use the funds from this IPO to progress its lead asset, zolucatetide, to Phase III in desmoid tumours.

items.title: ASCO26 Podcast: an analyst rundown of the best readouts and key trends
items.summary: Two oncology analysts share their insights from the ASCO 2026 show floor, while talking through the readouts that excited them most.

items.title: Pfizer signs licence agreement with Chai for AI drug discovery
items.summary: Pfizer and Chai Discovery have signed a licence deal enabling the former to incorporate Chai’s AI platform into its drug discovery operations.

items.title: Biogen’s salanersen gains FDA breakthrough therapy designation for SMA
items.summary: Biogen has received the breakthrough therapy designation from the FDA for salanersen (BIIB115), an investigational treatment for SMA.

items.title: ASCO26: Solid tumour data readouts outline Merck & Co’s oncology prowess
items.summary: Keytruda continues to shine in solid tumours, and other Merck & Co assets signal designs to address Keytruda's upcoming exclusivity loss.
